test_title: PYST 30: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

No coffee is butter.

No cream is coffee.

**Conclusions:**

I. No butter is cream.

II. All cream is butter.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f69352afc9d8a2dd3e7f7d43ace1b45c152fbd1c9172df727f7e4adee3fea36.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No butter is cream → Does not follow → (As no coffee is butter and no coffee is cream, So no butter is cream it is possible but not definite true)

II. All cream is butter → Does not follow → (As no coffee is butter and no coffee is cream, So all cream is butter is possible but no definite true)

Hence, the correct answer is "Neither conclusion I nor II follow".
